name: kaseya-gcal-sync
description: Scrapes Kaseya Center events and syncs them to Google Calendar

scripts.debug: node -e "require('./src/scraper').scrapeEvents().then(e => { console.log('Found', e.length, 'events'); e.forEach(ev => console.log('-', ev.name, '|', ev.dateText, ev.timeText, '|', ev.url)); })"
